newsitem.title: USA: Applied Cellular unit sees gains from acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Applied Cellular unit sees gains from acquisition.

text.p: Applied Cellular Technology Inc said Thursday it expects newly acquired Data Liquor Systems to add about $500,000 in revenues and between $120,000 to $150,000 in earnings over the coming year.
Applied Cellular said its 80 percent owned subsidiary Atlantic Systems completed acquisition today of Data Liquor Systems.
Terms of the acquisition were not disclosed, but the effective accounting date was July 29, 1997.
Data Liquor Systems is a reseller of hardware and software to beverage stores with over 140 installations in the Maryland-Washington, D.C.-Virginia-Delaware area.
Atlantic Systems resells PC based computer systems. It also provides a proprietary liquor store management software system, which runs under a Windows 95 Platform.
Applied Cellular said the acquisition of Data Liquor Systems will allow Atlantic Systems to market its Spirits '97 software to the existing Data Liquor System's customer base.
Applied Cellular is a specialty telecommunications and high-technology company.
